faqs.question: How do you decide between repairing and replacing a system in an older Piedmont home?
faqs.answer: By documented condition, not age alone. The diagnostic establishes what failed and what the rest of the unit looks like, then repair and replacement get priced side by side.

faqs.question: Why does my water pressure drop only when two fixtures run at once?
faqs.answer: That pattern points to restricted supply rather than a fixture problem, commonly a partially closed or failing valve, undersized lines, or buildup narrowing older pipe.

faqs.question: Is an air scrubber different from just buying better filters?
faqs.answer: Yes, they work differently and cover different things. A filter captures particles passing through it on the return side; an in-duct scrubber treats air continuously as it moves.

faqs.question: Can a generator power my well pump and HVAC together during an outage?
faqs.answer: With correct sizing, yes. Pumps and compressors draw hard at startup, so the load calculation accounts for surge demand, not just running watts.
